title: GPT-2 small, first block, with a sparse autoencoder on its MLP neurons

nodes.label: Embedding
nodes.about: Each token picks a row from the word table and a row from the position table, and the two are added. This is the stream.

nodes.label: Layer norm
nodes.about: Each token's row is shifted and rescaled to mean 0 and spread 1, then given a learnt scale and shift.

nodes.label: Query
nodes.about: What each token is looking for. 768 neurons, each with 768 slopes and an intercept.

nodes.label: Key
nodes.about: What each token offers to be found by.

nodes.label: Value
nodes.about: What each token hands over if another token looks at it.

nodes.label: Similarity
nodes.about: A query times a key, for every pair of tokens. A token cannot look at later ones. Head 1 of 12 is shown.

nodes.label: Attention weights
nodes.about: Each row of scores turned into shares that add to 1: how much each token takes from each earlier one. Head 1 of 12.

nodes.label: Mix the values
nodes.about: Each earlier token's value times the attention given to it, added up. The one step where tokens exchange information.

nodes.label: Output layer
nodes.about: A linear layer turning the mixed values into what attention adds to the stream.

nodes.label: Add to the stream
nodes.about: Attention's result is added to the stream; nothing is overwritten.

nodes.label: Layer norm
nodes.about: The same rescaling, with its own scale and shift.

nodes.label: MLP neurons
nodes.about: 3,072 neurons, each a weighted sum of the 768 channels passed through GELU. These are what the sparse autoencoder reads.

nodes.label: MLP layer 2
nodes.about: A linear layer going back down to 768.

nodes.label: Add to the stream
nodes.about: The MLP's result is added to the stream, which goes on to the next block.

nodes.label: 11 more blocks, then a score for every token
Minus the usual level
nodes.about: One learnt number per neuron, close to its average, is taken off. What is left is how this token differs from the usual.

nodes.label: Features
nodes.about: 32,768 neurons, each a weighted sum of the 3,072 MLP neurons passed through ReLU. For any one token almost all are zero.

nodes.label: The rebuild
nodes.about: Each feature's pattern times how hard it fired, added up, plus the usual level. The sparse autoencoder's attempt at the MLP neurons.
